text:
Zoe: Shared a fresh draft of the product launch post + benchmark appendix -> https://drive.re/redwood/launch-v3. Can ppl focus on the hero claim? debating 'median <50ms' vs '95th <220ms'.
Marcus: Reading. Are those numbers with the new KV cache enabled or cold-start?
Zoe: Numbers are warm-cache for Hosted in the main narrative; cold starts noted in appendix. Dedicated pool results are separate.
Alina: Legal flagged the '95th <220ms' line unless we include reproducible steps and the exact traffic mix. Also prefer 'typical p95' over raw '95th' phrasing.
Devyn: For engineers, include the bench snippet and env: `./bench_runner --model redwood-medium --seq 1024 --batch 2 --runs 200 --device a10g --cache warm`.
Marcus: GTM input: use median for hero headline to keep messaging crisp; call out p95 in sidebar for SREs.
Alina: OK. Legal will sign off if appendix has hardware table, dataset sample, RNG seed, and a note on measurement variance. @Devyn can you add those?
Devyn: Yup. I'll paste a minimal dataset sample and the harness link: https://ci.re/redwood/bench-lab. Also adding raw CSV logs.
Zoe: CTA routing question — webinar reg should add leads to the webinar list and tag for trial touchpoints. Can Ops-bot create routing: form -> webinar+trial-nurture, tag `launch-trial` and set followups at 4 & 10 days?
Ops-bot: Routing rule created: submission -> webinar-list, trial-nurture flow initiated. Tag attached: `launch-trial`. Followups scheduled: day 4, day 10. Awaiting confirmation to enable.
Zoe: Enable, thanks. Also quick approval needed on hero quote — we used a CTO line. @Marcus please confirm we didn't overpromise.
Marcus: Edited quote to remove absolutes and added "in our tests". Approved :+1:
Alina: Legal gives conditional OK after appendix updates :white_check_mark:
Zoe: Great. Final publish target set for tomorrow 11:30 PT. I'll lock the doc in 15m and drop the preflight checklist. Anything else?
Devyn: Appendix updated with GPU types, kernel flags, exact commands, RNG seed, dataset sample, and a short variance blurb. Linked to raw logs.
Marcus: Growth ready — prepping social copy and webinar landing page.
Zoe: Locking doc now. Thanks team! :rocket:
